description: In response to repeated cyber incidents and the failure of national-level preparedness, a coalition of EU member states led by France, Germany, and Poland pushes through an emergency mandate to establish a unified cyber defence command with real-time threat intelligence sharing, automated countermeasure deployment, and direct access to critical infrastructure telemetry. The initiative bypasses stalled legislation by invoking mutual defence clauses, marking the first time the Union treats cyber disruption as an existential threat requiring integrated military-grade response.
